Text_en: Exaggeration in the gender opposition of "male and female" is not a sign of consciousness; It is a sign of identity poverty. If the genders were switched, they would still stand in a hostile position, what matters to them is not "self-defense", but the defense of the gender label. In this view, the human being is removed and replaced by the ideology of the body.
